policy:
Validate per-color texture/bevel profiles on frozen scan poses.
All errors are regional byte units (0-255), not full-card accuracy percentages.

calibration.curvePolicy: Monotone per-channel tone offsets over source maximum channel. Only native texture selection, minus expanded bevel selection. Black gives its larger footer region three times the weight of the narrow rails and explicitly fits texture spread. Curves preserve source values at 0, 12 and 255. No per-printing coefficients.
calibration.bevelPolicy: Native pinline selection expanded outward seven canonical pixels, clipped by native frame selection. Per-color attenuation toward a measured backdrop; no underlying hidden texture is reconstructed.

decisions.W: Adopt texture curve and bevel blend.
decisions.U: Adopt texture curve and bevel blend.
decisions.B: Adopt contrast-prioritized texture curve and bevel blend. Held-out average texture color error rises by 0.92/255; contrast error falls 77%. Narrow side rails and lower texture have different source means, so one curve cannot match both.
decisions.R: Adopt bevel only. Reject trial texture curve: negligible contrast gain and worse validation color.
decisions.G: Adopt bevel only. Reject trial texture curve: worse contrast on calibration and validation.

blackLevelRevalidation.policy: Existing five PLC curves and texture/bevel corrections replay pixel-identically after shared black-level material integration.
